headlines.description: — Konnor Griffin hit a two-run single to key a five-run second inning and Henry Davis tacked on a two-run homer to lead the Pittsburgh Pirates over the NL Central champion Milwaukee Brewers 7-4 on Thursday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Konnor Griffin's 2-run double highlights a 5-run second inning as Pirates hold off Brewers 7-4

events.name: Los Angeles Dodgers at Cincinnati Reds

headlines.description: — The Los Angeles Dodgers clinched their fifth consecutive NL West division title and 13th in the 14 seasons, sparked by four hits from Kyle Tucker that included a first-inning home run in an 8-2 win over the Cincinnati Reds on Thursday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dodgers clinch 5th straight NL West title, 13th in 14 years, Tucker has 4 hits in 8-2 win over Reds

events.name: Athletics Athletics at Tampa Bay Rays

headlines.description: — Drew Rasmussen pitched five scoreless innings and the Tampa Bay Rays opened a five-game AL East lead with a 10-1 win over the Athletics on Thursday that extended their winning streak to six.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rays open 5-game AL East lead, beat Athletics 10-1 for 6th straight win

events.name: San Diego Padres at Colorado Rockies

headlines.description: — Xander Bogaerts homered and had an RBI triple during a seven-run second inning to help the San Diego Padres beat the reeling Colorado Rockies...
headlines.shortLinkText: Xander Bogaerts helps power a 7-run 2nd inning as the Padres roll past the reeling Rockies 9-2

events.name: Philadelphia Phillies at New York Mets

headlines.description: — Aaron Nola allowed three hits over seven innings and the Philadelphia Phillies beat the Mets 3-0 Thursday night to tie the Chicago Cubs for the top NL wild card in a game interrupted by a scary collision that led to New York first baseman Jared...
headlines.shortLinkText: Nola dominates Mets in 3-0 win as Phillies tie Cubs for top NL wild card

events.name: Kansas City Royals at Houston Astros

headlines.description: — Yordan Alvarez hit his 40th home run, one of five Houston long balls, and the Astros beat the Kansas City Royals 6-2 on Thursday night to move back over .500 and open a one-game lead over Texas in AL West.
headlines.shortLinkText: Alvarez hits 40th home run, Astros beat Royals 6-2 to move 1 game ahead of Rangers for AL West lead

events.name: Detroit Tigers at Chicago White Sox

headlines.description: — Munetaka Murakami hit his team-leading 32nd home run and the Chicago White Sox moved into a tie with idle Cleveland for first place in the AL Central with a 3-1 win over the Detroit Tigers on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Murakami hits 3-run homer, White Sox top Tigers 3-1 to move into 1st place tie in AL Central

events.name: Boston Red Sox at Texas Rangers

headlines.description: — Trevor Story hit a three-run home run off All-Star closer Jacob Latz in the eighth inning, capping a comeback from a three-run deficit as the Boston Red Sox beat Texas 4-3 on Thursday night and dropped the Rangers out of the AL West lead.
headlines.shortLinkText: Trevor Story's 3-run homer lifts Red Sox to 4-3 win, dropping Rangers into 2nd place in AL West

events.name: Minnesota Twins at Los Angeles Angels

headlines.description: — Mike Trout hit a tying RBI single in the 10th inning, and Wade Meckler followed with a winning RBI single to give the Los Angeles Angels a 5-4 victory over the Minnesota Twins on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Angels blow 9th-inning lead, then rally for 2 in the 10th to edge Twins 5-4
